# Studio By Ai21 Labs

AI21 Studio provides API access to Jurassic-1 large-language-models. Our models power text generation and comprehension features in thousands of live applications.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/studio-by-ai21-labs/.

## Actions

- **Create Assistant**: Create a new AI assistant in AI21 Studio.
- **Create Assistant Plan**: Create a new plan for an AI21 Studio assistant.
- **Create Assistant Route**: Create a new route for an AI21 Studio assistant.
- **Create Website Connector**: Create a website connector in AI21 Studio.
- **Get Assistant** (read-only): Retrieve an assistant by its unique identifier.
- **List Assistants** (read-only): Retrieve all assistants from AI21 Studio.
- **List Library Files** (read-only): List files in the workspace library with optional filtering.
- **List Models** (read-only): Retrieve information about all available AI21 models.
- **List Secrets** (read-only): Retrieve all secrets from AI21 Studio secret storage.
- **Modify Assistant**: Modify an existing AI21 Studio assistant.
- **Run Assistant**: Run an AI21 Studio assistant with conversational input.
- **Check Can Iframe** (read-only): Check if a URL can be embedded in an iframe.
- **Check Kirsh Grant Compliance** (read-only): Check compliance for Kirsh grant IDs.
- **Compare Text** (read-only): Compare two text strings and identify differences.
- **Create Aftersales Parts Classification Batch**: Create a batch job for Fnac Aftersales parts classification.
- **Create Demo**: Create a new demo in AI21 Studio.
- **Create Kirsh Grant Compliance Preview** (read-only): Preview grant compliance for Kirsh grants.
- **Create MCP Storage**: Create MCP (Model Context Protocol) storage in AI21 Studio.
- **Create Secret**: Save a secret in AI21 Studio.
- **Delete Assistant**: Delete an assistant by its unique ID.
- **Delete Assistant Route**: Delete a route from an AI21 Studio assistant.
- **Delete Demo**: Delete a demo by its unique ID.
- **Delete MCP Storage**: Delete an MCP (Model Context Protocol) storage configuration by its unique ID.
- **Delete Secret**: Delete a secret by its unique ID.
- **Delete Website Connector**: Permanently delete a website connector by its unique identifier.
- **Download Modified Document** (read-only): Download a modified document from AI21 Labs Studio.
- **Generate Requirements**: Generate requirements from a query or task description.
- **Generate Thread Name**: Generate a thread name from a query or conversation context.
- **Get Assistant Route** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific route for an AI21 Studio assistant.
- **Get Assistants By MCP** (read-only): Retrieve all assistants associated with a specific MCP (Model Context Protocol) storage configuration.
- **Get Batch Prediction Status** (read-only): Check the status of a Fnac Aftersales parts classification batch prediction job.
- **Get Demo** (read-only): Retrieve a demo by its unique ID.
- **Get Library Batch Status** (read-only): Get the ingestion status of a library batch.
- **Get MCP Storage** (read-only): Retrieve a specific MCP (Model Context Protocol) storage configuration by its unique ID.
- **Get Output Explanation** (read-only): Get output explanation for an execution (cached or generated).
- **Get Plan** (read-only): Retrieve a specific plan from an AI21 Studio assistant.
- **Get Website Connector By ID** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific website connector by its ID.
- **Get Website Connector Status** (read-only): Retrieve the status of a website connector ingestion.
- **Get Website Connector URL Status** (read-only): Retrieve the status of a specific URL in the website connector.
- **Grant Kirsh Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve Kirsh grant metadata by grant ID.
- **Ingest Website Connector**: Ingest website content via sitemap URL in AI21 Studio.
- **Ingest Website Connector URL**: Ingest a website URL into AI21 Studio's website connector.
- **Kirsh Grant Metadata Preview** (read-only): Retrieve grant metadata from the Kirsh preview endpoint.
- **List Available Models** (read-only): Retrieve all available models from AI21 Studio settings.
- **List Demos** (read-only): Retrieve all demos from AI21 Studio.
- **List MCP Storage** (read-only): Retrieve all MCP (Model Context Protocol) storage configurations from AI21 Studio.
- **List Plans** (read-only): List all plans for a specific assistant.
- **List Website Connectors** (read-only): Retrieve website connector information from AI21 Studio.
- **List Workspace Models** (read-only): Retrieve all workspace models by organization from AI21 Studio.
- **Modify Assistant Plan**: Modify an existing assistant plan in AI21 Studio.
- **Modify Assistant Route**: Modify an existing route within an assistant.
- **Retry Ingest Website**: Retry ingestion of a website in AI21 Studio.
- **Sync Website Connector**: Sync a website connector in AI21 Studio.
- **Update Demo**: Update an existing demo in Studio by AI21 Labs.
- **Update MCP Storage**: Update an existing MCP (Model Context Protocol) storage configuration in AI21 Studio.
- **Update Secret**: Update an existing secret in AI21 Studio.
- **Validate Plan** (read-only): Validate Python code for an AI21 Studio assistant plan.
